cohort: The study included 239 patients who had resolved their pregnancies, consisting of 92 adolescents and 147 adult women.
finding: Maternal complications such as miscarriages, UTIs, and hemorrhages were more frequent in adolescent pregnancies compared to adult pregnancies.
mod_finding: 39.5% of adult mothers had cesarean sections, and tears at delivery occurred in 2.2% of adolescents.
